mapper.select: SELECT id AS trip_id, user_id, trip_name, status, start_date, end_date, total_target_amount FROM trips WHERE id = #{tripId} AND is_deleted = 0
SELECT c.country_name FROM trip_countries tc INNER JOIN countries c ON c.id = tc.country_id WHERE tc.trip_id = #{tripId} AND tc.is_deleted = 0 ORDER BY tc.display_order ASC

SELECT c.country_name, tc.target_budget AS budget FROM trip_countries tc INNER JOIN countries c ON c.id = tc.country_id WHERE tc.trip_id = #{tripId} AND tc.is_deleted = 0 ORDER BY tc.display_order ASC

SELECT DATE(created_at) AS date, CASE WHEN transaction_type = 'CHARGE' AND transfer_method = 'AUTO_SAVING' THEN '월 목표 자동 송금' WHEN transaction_type = 'CHARGE' THEN '월렛 수동 충전' WHEN transaction_type = 'WITHDRAW' THEN '월렛 출금' WHEN transaction_type = 'CARD_TOPUP' THEN '트래블카드 충전' WHEN transaction_type = 'EXCHANGE_SELL' THEN '외화 환전' WHEN transaction_type = 'MISSION_REWARD' THEN '미션 보상' WHEN transaction_type = 'REFUND' THEN '환불' ELSE '잔액 조정' END AS label, CASE WHEN direction = 'OUT' THEN -amount ELSE amount END AS amount FROM wallet_ledger WHERE wallet_id = #{walletId} ORDER BY created_at DESC, id DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT COUNT(*) AS total, SUM(CASE WHEN is_completed = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS completed FROM trip_checklist_items WHERE trip_id = #{tripId} AND checklist_type = #{checklistType} AND is_excluded = 0 AND is_deleted = 0

SELECT COUNT(*) AS total, SUM(CASE WHEN payment_status = 'PREPAID' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS prepaid, SUM(CASE WHEN payment_status = 'ONSITE' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS onsite FROM trip_schedules WHERE trip_id = #{tripId} AND is_deleted = 0
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(amount), 0) FROM transactions WHERE trip_id = #{tripId} AND is_pre_expense = 0 AND transaction_type = 'WITHDRAWAL' AND is_deleted = 0

WITH RECURSIVE trip_dates AS ( SELECT start_date AS date FROM trips WHERE id = #{tripId} UNION ALL SELECT DATE_ADD(date, INTERVAL 1 DAY) FROM trip_dates WHERE date < (SELECT end_date FROM trips WHERE id = #{tripId}) ) SELECT td.date AS date, COALESCE(SUM(t.amount), 0) AS amount FROM trip_dates td LEFT JOIN transactions t ON t.transaction_date = td.date AND t.trip_id = #{tripId} AND t.is_pre_expense = 0 AND t.transaction_type = 'WITHDRAWAL' AND t.is_deleted = 0 GROUP BY td.date ORDER BY td.date ASC

SELECT sc.category_name, SUM(t.amount) AS amount FROM transactions t INNER JOIN spending_categories sc ON sc.id = t.category_id WHERE t.trip_id = #{tripId} AND t.is_pre_expense = 0 AND t.transaction_type = 'WITHDRAWAL' AND t.is_deleted = 0 GROUP BY sc.category_name ORDER BY amount DESC

SELECT c.country_name, COALESCE(SUM(t.amount), 0) AS amount, tc.target_budget AS budget FROM trip_countries tc INNER JOIN countries c ON c.id = tc.country_id LEFT JOIN transactions t ON t.trip_country_id = tc.id AND t.is_pre_expense = 0 AND t.transaction_type = 'WITHDRAWAL' AND t.is_deleted = 0 WHERE tc.trip_id = #{tripId} AND tc.is_deleted = 0 GROUP BY c.country_name, tc.target_budget, tc.display_order ORDER BY tc.display_order ASC

WITH category_totals AS ( SELECT tc.id AS trip_country_id, c.country_name, sc.category_name, SUM(t.amount) AS amount, SUM(SUM(t.amount)) OVER (PARTITION BY tc.id) AS country_total, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY tc.id ORDER BY SUM(t.amount) DESC, sc.category_name ASC ) AS category_rank, tc.display_order FROM trip_countries tc INNER JOIN countries c ON c.id = tc.country_id INNER JOIN transactions t ON t.trip_country_id = tc.id AND t.is_pre_expense = 0 AND t.transaction_type = 'WITHDRAWAL' AND t.is_deleted = 0 INNER JOIN spending_categories sc ON sc.id = t.category_id WHERE tc.trip_id = #{tripId} AND tc.is_deleted = 0 GROUP BY tc.id, c.country_name, sc.category_name, tc.display_order ) SELECT country_name, category_name, amount, country_total FROM category_totals WHERE category_rank = 1 ORDER BY display_order ASC
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM receipts WHERE trip_id = #{tripId} AND is_deleted = 0
